fields.title: Excessive Rainfall Discussion
fields.office: NWS Weather Prediction Center College Park MD

sections.heading: DAY 1 VALID 16Z WED OCT 21 2026 - 12Z THU OCT 22 2026
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MODERATE RISK OF EXCESSIVE RAINFALL FOR PORTIONS OF THE MIDDLE OHIO VALLEY...

sections.heading: MIDDLE OHIO VALLEY
sections.text: Training thunderstorms along a slow-moving front will produce rainfall rates over 2 inches per hour. Soils are saturated from rain earlier this week, so flash flooding is likely, especially in urban areas and small streams.
